title: libcuflynx parameters (<prefix>_parameters.json; parameterisations/<name>/<name>_parameters.json)
description: Parameter values, nested as instance, sub-instance, variable. A model's file, <prefix>_parameters.json beside its module array, has its instances at the top ({"aortic_root": {"C": {...}}, "heart": {"lv": {"E_A": {...}}}}); a module's parameterisation, and a calibrated result of one, is rooted at the module (a component's variables at the top, {"C": {...}}; a supermodule's sub-instances, {"lv": {"E_A": {...}}}). A path is the name CA's users write: aortic_root/C, heart/lv/E_A, global/R. Rules: a leaf (one parameter) is an object with "value"; every other object is an instance or sub-instance; "global" at the top holds the global constants; "global", "value" and "schema_version" are reserved, so no instance, sub-instance or variable has those names; in a model's file every top-level key but "global" is an instance. Written by cuflynx-upgrade parameters from a parameters CSV. Read by libcuflynx/utilities/parameters_file.py (read_parameters_file).

global.description: The global constants: {variable: parameter}. A model's file sets them for the whole model (written global/R or R); a parameterisation, those its module sets.

propertyNames.description: "value" is reserved: it marks a parameter.

entry.description: An object with "value" is a parameter; any other is an instance or sub-instance.

propertyNames.description: A sub-instance or variable may not be named "value", "global" or "schema_version".

instance.description: An instance or sub-instance: {sub-instance or variable: ...}.

value.description: Required. The value: a number, or text such as EMPTY_MUST_BE_FILLED.

units.description: Its units, as the module config names them.

data_reference.description: Where the value comes from. Default: empty.

origin.description: What set the value: measured (cite the source in data_reference), inherited (carried from the original model, constrained by nothing), set_by_hand (chosen by us; give the reason), derived (calculated by the derivation the leaf names; required with derivation) or calibrated (fitted by a calibration; written with the calibrated value, which drops derivation and reason, so cuflynx-derive --write never overwrites it; a provenance diagram shows it as calibrated before the run). A provenance diagram shows a value without an origin as unclassified.

reason.description: Why the value was chosen. Required when origin is set_by_hand.

derivation.description: The name of the derivation in the <name>_derivations.json beside this file that calculates the value; value is then its cached result, which cuflynx-derive checks and --write refreshes. Its origin must be derived. A calibrated value has no derivation. Default: none.

allOf.description: A value set by hand gives the reason it was chosen.
A value a derivation calculates (it names a derivation) has origin derived: add "origin": "derived", or remove derivation if the value is set another way (cuflynx-derive --write sets both).

parameter.description: One parameter. Other string keys (a module library's "sourced") are kept and not read.
